description.zh: 视频叙事与电影镜头提示词合集
description.en: Video storytelling and cinematic prompt collection

prompts.title: The Unsent Letter on the Last Ferry
prompts.prompt:
15 seconds, 2.39:1, restrained realist cinema at a winter harbor at night. Identity lock: a 28-year-old woman with shoulder-length black hair, faint freckles across her nose, a dark gray wool coat, and an old silver ring on her right hand. Keep the same face and wardrobe in every shot.

0–4 seconds: Static medium shot in an empty lower-deck ferry cabin. She sits by the window pressing an unstamped letter under her palm. Harbor lights sway with the vessel and rain runs backward across the glass.

4–9 seconds: Slide slowly along the table into a profile close-up. An announcement says the ferry will soon return. She looks toward the small red shape of a mailbox on the opposite shore but says nothing.

9–15 seconds: Cut to the stern without crossing the axis. She runs from the cabin, stops at the railing, and places the letter back inside her coat instead of throwing it into the sea. Pull back as the ferry leaves the pier.

Sound: diesel engine, rain on glass, hydraulic door, quiet announcement, then only the wake. No music, subtitles, crying, slow-motion running, face changes, or sudden extra passengers.

prompts.title: The Bakery After the Blackout
prompts.prompt:
10 seconds, 16:9, warm slice-of-life cinema. A storm causes a neighborhood blackout inside a small bakery. A 58-year-old shop owner with short gray hair and a dark green apron stands across the counter from a nine-year-old boy carrying a yellow schoolbag. Keep their identities, apron, and bag consistent.

0–3 seconds: The lights go out and the oven fan stops. Only blue-gray lightning outlines the room. Both freeze; the boy holds his paper bag close.

3–7 seconds: The owner strikes one match, lights a small counter candle, and slides a fresh round loaf toward the boy. Rack focus slowly from the flame to their faces as warm light builds.

7–10 seconds: The boy breaks the loaf in half and offers the larger piece back. She pauses for 0.4 seconds, then smiles. Power returns along the street outside, but the bakery remains primarily candlelit. End on their hands and the bread steam.

Sound: rain, power cut, match strike, bread crust, and distant cheers. No dialogue, subtitles, brands, changing candle position, restored loaf, or altered ages.

prompts.title: Three Seconds Too Late on the Platform
prompts.prompt:
12 seconds, 2.39:1, modern urban mystery at a terminal metro station in the early morning. Identity locks: a male reporter in a sand trench coat holding a folded newspaper in his left hand; a female station worker in a navy uniform with a blank name badge.

0–3 seconds: Ultra-wide empty platform as a passengerless train prepares to close. Track low and parallel as the reporter runs from deep background, leaving continuous wet footprints.

3–6 seconds: The doors close in front of him. Inside, a man with the exact same face but a black coat raises his hand in sync behind the glass. Keep the image stable and avoid horror distortion.

6–9 seconds: The train starts moving, but the duplicate remains in place like a reflection for half a second before being carried away. The reporter steps back and drops the newspaper.

9–12 seconds: The station worker enters foreground and picks it up. Its layout suggests tomorrow's date without requiring readable text. Push slowly toward her confused eyes as tunnel wind lifts one page corner.

Sound: door tone, footsteps, train acceleration, paper impact, one low sustained note. No gore, monsters, garbled headlines, or axis violations.

prompts.title: Kitchen to Cosmos Match Transition
prompts.prompt:
8 seconds, 9:16, poetic vertical short using one natural occlusion to move from reality into imagination. In a small kitchen at night, a 12-year-old girl in loose white pajamas places blueberries in a glass bowl. Her father appears only as hands with dark blue sweater cuffs.

0–3 seconds: Overhead macro. The final blueberry rolls once around the bowl edge and stops. The father pours milk slowly from above frame until white liquid covers the lens.

3–5 seconds: As milk fully occludes the view, transform it seamlessly into a milky-white nebula while the blueberries become deep blue planets. Maintain position and motion direction as the camera continues downward.

5–8 seconds: The nebula returns gradually to the breakfast bowl. The girl stirs once, dawn appears at the window, and she looks toward her father and smiles without revealing his face.

Use blue, milk white, and dawn gold. Bridge pouring sound into a low cosmic ambience, then return to a spoon touching glass. No dialogue, text, hard cuts, astronauts, or changes to the kitchen layout.

prompts.title: The Umbrella Left at Dawn
prompts.prompt: Create a 12-second quiet story at a city bus stop just after rain. A delivery rider in a faded green jacket notices a red umbrella left beneath the bench as an elderly passenger boards a departing bus. Track from the wet pavement to the umbrella, hold as the rider looks between it and the bus, then follow him running only a few steps and passing it through the closing door. Preserve faces, clothing, bus direction, umbrella color, and street layout. End with the rider reflected in the bus window as it leaves. Sound: rain drip, idling engine, door warning, footsteps. No dialogue, heroic slow motion, extra passengers, changing props, text, or watermark.

prompts.title: Desert Radio Signal
prompts.prompt: 10 seconds, restrained near-future science fiction in a desert research cabin at sunset. A field engineer wearing a sand-colored utility suit adjusts one analog radio while a narrow antenna turns outside the window. Start with a macro of the frequency needle, pull back to reveal the engineer, then let a repeating signal synchronize with distant lights appearing one by one across the horizon. Keep the radio geometry, hand position, cabin layout, horizon, and wardrobe consistent. The engineer stays calm and records the pattern on blank graph paper. Sound: static, three clean tones, wind, pencil. No aliens, holograms, readable writing, equipment morphing, lens explosions, or watermark.

prompts.title: Apartment Seasons Window Match
prompts.prompt: Create a 12-second locked-camera transition through four seasons in the same small apartment. The composition never changes: one window, wooden table, blue chair, ceramic plant pot, and a young adult reading in profile. Move from spring rain to summer afternoon, autumn leaves, and winter snow using natural occlusion as the reader turns one page at each transition. Preserve identity, pose progression, furniture geometry, book size, and camera height. Only wardrobe layers, exterior weather, plant growth, and motivated light may change. Sound should blend rain, insects, leaves, and muted snow ambience. No time-lapse flicker, room redesign, duplicated objects, text, or watermark.

prompts.title: One Take Through the Theater
prompts.prompt: Create a 15-second continuous take through an old theater five minutes before opening. Begin behind a stagehand carrying one coil of rope, pass through the wing as two performers cross in opposite directions, follow a warm practical light into the auditorium, and end facing the curtain as it begins to rise. Maintain the stagehand's identity, rope, performer costumes, architecture, screen direction, and plausible walking speed. Camera movement should be smooth but human, with natural focus transitions and no hidden teleport cuts. Sound: footsteps, rope fibers, distant tuning, audience murmur, curtain mechanism. No changing faces, duplicated crew, impossible corridors, readable posters, or watermark.

prompts.title: Pirates Meet Their Match
prompts.prompt: [Style + Lens + Atmosphere] Rugged and realistic live-action film shots, full HD, photo-realistic, open sea under natural daylight, handheld camera with slight natural shake, authentic film grain, pure live-action energy. [Image Reference] Use the provided photo as the strict facial, bald head, dense black beard, facial structure, and stocky body reference for the main pirate. Keep his exact portrait. Only have him wear rough classic pirate clothing. [Timeline by seconds] 0-3 seconds: [Medium close-up] Bald pirate on his deck, face full of pure malice, shouting loudly and fiercely pointing at the nearby merchant ship. Strong commanding energy. Handheld shot. 3-6 seconds: [Dynamic wide-angle tracking] Boarding action erupts. Pirates sway and leap onto the deck of another ship, chaotic real action. Camera follows with natural shake and motion blur. 6-8 seconds: [Wide shot] Pirates freeze. Elderly ladies calmly sitting on the deck knitting, completely unmoved. 8-10 seconds: [Close-up] One old lady looks up, making the exact "Oh, damn, here we go again" expression—an exasperated eye roll, tired smirk. 10-13 seconds: [Handheld action] The old ladies burst out: fierce slaps, kicks, punches. Real impact effects, bodies responding with real weight. Chaotic handheld shot, strong motion blur. 13-15 seconds: [Medium wide shot] All other pirates fall. Bald pirate alone, tightly surrounded by the advancing old ladies. Shock filled on his face. Final tense freeze frame. [Style and Quality Enhancement] Photo-realistic live-action full HD, heavy natural film grain, detailed textures, perfect real-world physics and impact effects, coherent faces, stable portraits, cinematic lighting, pure cinematic realism.

prompts.title: Summer Beverage Campaign
prompts.prompt: Create a premium beverage commercial featuring Luna, a photorealistic 24-year-old woman with long honey-brown wavy hair, radiant skin, expressive hazel eyes, and a bright natural smile. She wears a fitted white crop top, high-waisted light blue denim shorts, white sneakers, layered gold necklaces, and stylish sunglasses resting on her head. Bright tropical summer atmosphere, premium commercial quality, vibrant citrus color palette, ultra-realistic lifestyle storytelling, cinematic camera work. The video opens with Luna already on screen, relaxing on the hood of a vintage yellow convertible parked beside a beach road. She catches an ice-cold Fanta tossed from off-camera, smiles, and says, "Summer starts now!" She flips the can playfully before popping it open. Crisp fizz escapes as sunlight glistens across the chilled aluminum. Macro close-ups showcase sparkling condensation, vibrant orange bubbles, and refreshing citrus slices splashing through the air as Luna enjoys her first sip. The scene shifts to a lively beach volleyball court where she joins friends for a fun match. Between plays, everyone grabs ice-cold Fanta cans from a cooler, laughing and celebrating every point. As golden hour arrives, Luna and her friends gather around a retro food truck serving burgers and fries. They share food, toast their Fanta cans together, and dance to live street musicians nearby while colorful lights begin glowing overhead. The final sequence takes place on the beach at sunset. Friends light sparklers, laugh around a bonfire, and run toward the shoreline. Luna raises her chilled Fanta toward the camera and smiles, Luna: "Taste the sunshine!" The camera pulls back to reveal the glowing beach, crashing waves, warm sunset sky, and joyful summer celebration. Premium beverage advertising, cinematic lifestyle photography, realistic water and lighting effects, smooth gimbal movements, shallow depth of field, vibrant orange tones, ultra-realistic commercial quality, 4K HDR, 16:9 wides

prompts.title: Backstage Day-in-the-Life Montage
prompts.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image of the woman as a locked character reference. CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic. She records herself throughout, mostly holding camera, occasional hands-free. Natural hand tremors, crooked framing, slow autofocus, awkward zooms, accidental face crops, brief framing losses. Camcorder never visible. LOOK: Soft tape texture, mild blur, electronic grain, glowing highlights, auto-exposure fluctuations, restrained contrast, natural skin tones. Lighting: warm morning apartment → cooler van daylight → intense colorful backstage/stage. STYLE: Fast energetic day-in-life montage, sharp cuts, accelerated transitions. Reflective VO over footage (no sync dialogue). Pace builds from sleepy morning to high-energy finale. Character: Young beautiful white woman, 20s. Long glossy dark-brown hair, striking features, large eyes, glowing skin, soft pink lips. Slim toned figure. Outfits change: cozy loungewear home, stylish casual in van, glamorous stage look. All fully cover arms/torso. Settings: Stylish apt bedroom morning → luxury van day → busy backstage + concert stage night. Storyboard 15s, 5 cuts: (~3s bedroom, cam on table, soft morning light) Sits up slowly, stretches, fixes messy hair, packs bag. VO: “Some mornings begin before I’m even fully awake.” (~3s van, handheld selfie, window light) By window, sunlight on face, checks phone. VO: “I spend so much time on the road, this place almost feels like home.” (~3s van macro) Close-up fingers choosing song, sunlight flickers on screen/hand. Road noise only. (~3s backstage, fast handheld) Makeup, hair, costume, staff rushing, focused breath. VO: “And then everything suddenly starts moving at once.” (~3s stage, wide to close-up) Lights ignite, steps through curtains, silhouette then confident smile, cut to black. VO: “This moment is why I keep doing it.”

prompts.title: Morning Dog Walk Vlog
prompts.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image of the woman as a locked character reference. Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog, camera never visible. Start in selfie mode at arm’s length as Emma exits her apartment with her golden retriever. Keep the first 20–30 seconds entirely handheld; later set it on a park bench or low wall for wide shots. Imperfect operation: subtle shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zoom, exposure breathing, occasional face crop and natural motion blur. EMMA: white woman, mid-20s, long light-brown messy ponytail, green eyes, minimal makeup, oversized gray hoodie, black biker shorts, white sneakers, small crossbody bag. Warm analog tape texture, gentle grain, soft sharpness, sunlight halation, realistic skin, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts. Sunny quiet suburb: tree-lined sidewalks, homes, birds, a small green park, few people, golden morning light. Selfie: the excited dog pulls Emma outside. She smiles: “Good morning.” “Someone couldn't wait.” On the sidewalk the dog sniffs every tree; she laughs, adjusts the leash: “He has to inspect every single tree.” Still handheld entering the park, the dog freezes on a squirrel. Emma shakes her head: “Oh... there we go.” After the handheld opening, she sets the camera on a bench, throws a tennis ball and the dog races after it: “Worth waking up early.” She picks it up, walks beneath the trees, brushes back her hair and looks up: “It's actually really peaceful out here.” The dog returns but drops the ball halfway; she laughs: “Close enough.” On the bench, the dog lies beside her; she scratches behind his ears: “I think he's happier than I am.” Walking home in selfie mode: “Coffee is definitely next.” She smiles into the lens: “See you later,” waves, and ends recording. Audio: birds, leash jingle, footsteps, dog panting, quiet neighborhood. Authentic spontaneous lifestyle vlog, not polished advertising; stable character, dog and wardrobe. No text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, extra people, visible camera, or artifacts.

prompts.title: Iced Coffee UGC Commercial
